name: Jayesh Anil Jadhav
summary:
Dynamic and result-driven Network & Security Specialist with 13+ years of hands-on experience in designing,
implementing, and managing secure IT infrastructure across banking and enterprise environments. Proven leader with
expertise in Network Access Control (NAC), Proxies, Routing, Switching, Firewalls, SD-WAN, Load Balancers and Azure
cloud. Adept in leading cross-functional teams (30+ engineers), managing audits, driving vendor coordination, and
ensuring SLA adherence. Adept at driving strategic cyber security initiatives, leading audits, and coordinating regulatory
compliance, while also mentoring teams and overseeing critical infrastructure. Currently responsible for Network
Security, cybersecurity, compliance, internal audit, and RBI audit at Axis Bank. Seeking to leverage deep technical
expertise and leadership skills in a strategic Network Security or Infrastructure Management role.
